correctness.rationale: The disjoint unique-semicircle-start decomposition is exact for continuous independent points; radial arclength density, π-shift and h derivative give exact two-sector tangent formulas. Uniform Taylor remainder on [-1,1] gives 2h-1=π²g/m³+O(m^-5) and w=1/2+O(m^-2). With n/m³≤T, the integrated exponential remainder is uniform O_T(m^-2). The explicit conditional density follows from Bayes and converges in total variation; small/large t follow from cosine expansion and one-point Gaussian Laplace method. Replayed deterministic side-sector checks and independent direct-polygon simulations agree. None of the finite checks substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: Center containment is a natural sample-coverage invariant. The law identifies a sharp sample-complexity scale m³ where polygonal parity remains visible as the body tends to a circle, quantifies the complete transition by an explicit universal function with controlled O_T(m^-2) error, and gives the associated non-symmetric conditioned side-position law. This is not an arbitrary parameter slice or mere reproduction of the known fixed-m directional mass or even-m Wendel formula; the two-limit interaction and conditioning explain the geometric effect.
